about_the_game:
This is an original soundtrack featuring newly composed songs from the idol × city-building simulation game “Heroic Songs: the Remix!”

In addition to the BGM for the building and story segments, this edition includes the full choruses of “Follow the Glow” and “Rupert's tears” which cannot be heard in the main game.
